name: dev-digest
description: Dev Digest AI plugins for Claude Code: skills, agents and hooks for everyday engineering work.

plugins.name: architecture-reviewer
plugins.description: Read-only architecture review of a staged diff: code in the wrong layer or module, cross-module reach-ins, re-declared contracts.

plugins.name: dev-digest-stack
plugins.description: Stack skills for TypeScript web apps: React, Next.js, Fastify, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Zod, onion architecture, testing and dependency audits.

plugins.name: engineering-foundations
plugins.description: Shared skills (security, engineering insights, Mermaid, review severity) and read-only Bash guards used by the dev-digest agent plugins.

plugins.name: git-rebase-sync
plugins.description: Rebases onto the fresh default branch before every git commit, with conflict summaries and a recovery playbook.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Researcher agent for questions that need docs, specs, changelogs or prior art, returning cited conclusions.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development pipeline: spec, plan, implement, review, test and verify with dedicated agents, plus run and retro workflows.

plugins.name: summarize-changes
plugins.description: Summarizes recent git changes into a short, readable digest.
